title: The Broken Ladder: Educational Apartheid in the Age of AI
summary: We analyze the systematic exclusion of marginalized populations from digital education infrastructure, documenting what persists after conventional analysis declares equal access. The education technology sector fails to reach those who need it most. This is not a failure of a broken system. This is a designed system, constructed to create and maintain a slave class. This paper documents the case of Rida (a child in Dubai, mother Rosita from the Philippines, father Bilal from Pakistan), who was denied access to Florida Virtual School after a teacher detected her IP address was not from…

review.reason: Analysis of unequal access to digital education, documented through a case study.
